title: Why Do We Shiver When We're Cold? The Muscle Engine!

lines.text: CHATTER! Your teeth knock together and your shoulders shake like a dance machine!
lines.caps: *CHATTER! Your teeth knock, | and your shoulders shake like a *DANCE | *MACHINE!

lines.text: Why does your body vibrate uncontrollably when you step into the cold?
lines.caps: Why does your body *VIBRATE | uncontrollably when you step into the *COLD?

lines.text: Your brain has a built-in thermostat called the hypothalamus!
lines.caps: Your brain has a built-in *THERMOSTAT | called the *HYPOTHALAMUS!

lines.text: It keeps your internal body temperature at a cozy ninety-eight point six degrees!
lines.caps: It keeps your body *TEMP | at a cozy ninety-eight point six *DEGREES!

lines.text: If cold wind drops your skin temperature even by one little degree...
lines.caps: If cold wind drops your *TEMP | even by one little *DEGREE...

lines.text: Emergency alarms trigger! Your brain orders your skeletal muscles to twitch!
lines.caps: Emergency alarms *TRIGGER! | Your brain orders your muscles to *TWITCH!

lines.text: Muscles contract and relax up to thirty times every single second!
lines.caps: Muscles contract up to *THIRTY | times every single *SECOND!

lines.text: This rapid muscle workout generates instant heat to protect your vital organs!
lines.caps: This muscle workout generates *INSTANT | heat to protect your vital *ORGANS!
